title: [Feature Request] Dedicated copy, paste, clear buttons and auto-trim for better text handling
summary: ### Is your feature request related to a problem? Please describe. Yes. I'm always frustrated when I have to use Android's native long-press pop-up menus just to copy command outputs or paste text. Additionally, manually backspacing a long command or dealing with accidental trailing whitespaces/newlines makes the workflow tedious and slows down command execution. ### Describe the solution you'd like I would like a more streamlined, button-driven UI for text management that includes: 1. A quick-clear ("X") button inside the input field when text is present. 2. A one-tap paste button next to the input field. 3. Dedicated copy buttons for both the command input and the last command output window. 4. Automatic trimming of leading/trailing spaces and empty lines. ### Describe alternatives you've considered I have considered relying on standard Android keyboard clipboard shortcuts and using the terminal `clear` command, but these workarounds require too many taps and lack the seamless convenience of dedicated UI buttons. ### Additional context These quality-of-life, Material You-style enhancements would greatly minimize tedious text selection and significantly improve the overall user experience for frequent command execution.
